dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, does Thailand have four seasons?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, dʌz ˈtaɪlænd ˈhæv ˈfɔːr ˈsiːzənz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, we have three. Hot, rainy, and cool.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, wiː ˈhæv ˈθriː. ˈhɑːt, ˈreɪni, ənd ˈkuːl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Canada has four. Winter is very cold.
dialogue.reading: ˈkænədə ˈhæz ˈfɔːr. ˈwɪntər ɪz ˈvɛri ˈkoʊld.
